figures.finding: Curaçao had no film incentive in force in February 2025: a programme with a 26% tax benefit on certain production expenses had been proposed to the government and awaited approval; Curaçao productions can use the Netherlands-Canada co-production treaty, which Telefilm Canada confirmed applies to the island.

value.treaty: Netherlands/Canada Film and Television Co-Production Treaty

figures.applies: CW, as of February 2025 (no later approval found)

sources.said: Curaçao has been officially recognized as a participant in the Netherlands/Canada Film and Television Co-Production Treaty … The confirmation came from Telefilm Canada … a film incentive program has been proposed to the government, suggesting a 26% tax benefit on specific industry-related expenses. … Stakeholders are urging the government to approve the film incentive program
